title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Marine-Pollutant Surcharge Rate and Computation
content:
## Clause

Dangerous Goods Acceptance goods whose acceptance carries the marine-pollutant marking pay a marine-pollutant surcharge when they are loaded. It is a separate entry, written alongside the hazardous-cargo surcharge entry and worked out independently of it: the category's marine-pollutant rate per container multiplied by the containers on the acceptance. None of the class, packing-group or lane uplifts is applied to it, no contract discount reduces it, and no weight exemption removes it. It is expressed to two decimal places. Goods without the marking pay no marine-pollutant surcharge.

## Rate per container (USD)

| Category | Marine-pollutant rate |
|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 40.00 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 50.00 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 75.00 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 75.00 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 75.00 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 100.00 |

## Worked cases

| Category | Marked marine pollutant | Containers | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | yes | 3 | 225.00 |
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | yes | 2 | 80.00, even for a light acceptance |
| AHL DG Special Approval | yes | 1 | 100.00 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | no | 4 | none |

## Point of judgement

**The customer holds a contract that earns a discount elsewhere. Does it reduce this charge?** No; this charge takes no contract discount.
